packetValidation.itemCheckRestaurantBinding: Rows do not carry a restaurantId field; all 80 are bound by the immutable path and the same official ciao-osteria.com/menus source URL.

identity.name: Ciao Osteria
identity.notes: The official homepage, location page, standing menu, order page, and restaurant-linked Uber Eats store all identify the same single Centreville restaurant and phone 703-543-8955. No other business or location was merged.

sources.excerpt: Official homepage identifies the Centreville restaurant and publishes six current weekly/take-home food products plus a raw-or-undercooked consumer advisory.
Official location page lists 14115 St Germain Dr, Centreville, VA 20121 and 703-543-8955.
Current restaurant-issued HTML menu covers Antipasti, Insalata, Primi, Secondi, pizzas, Pesce, sides, and Kid's Corner. Descriptions are used only for explicit positive ingredient/allergen evidence.
Official order page links Uber Eats, DoorDash, and SkyTab pickup for this restaurant.
Official catering page offers customized menus by inquiry but publishes no fixed catering product catalog or allergen document.

Live restaurant-linked store for 14115 Saint Germain Dr exposes current food and nonalcoholic ordering sections, descriptions, sizes, sides, desserts, and beverages. Page-wide checks found no allergen, allergy, may-contain, cross-contact, nutrition, or ingredients disclosure.

Restaurant-linked DoorDash surface identifies the St Germain Drive store and the same current category structure; dynamic item loading was not needed because the live Uber and official surfaces establish the boundary.
Official pickup link redirected to an empty SkyTab shell at the provider root during retrieval, so it contributes no product or allergen claims.

Official-domain and BentoBox/CDN document searches returned the current homepage/menu but no restaurant-issued allergen matrix, nutrition guide, ingredient PDF, FAQ disclosure, or downloadable menu document.
Targeted web searches returned official menus, linked ordering pages, and unrelated or third-party dietary mentions, but no attributable Ciao Osteria allergen matrix or cross-contact statement.

findings.summary: All authoritative current surfaces resolve to the single Ciao Osteria at 14115 St Germain Dr, Centreville, VA 20121.

The current logical boundary contains 109 food and nonalcoholic products across the official standing menu, weekly specials, and restaurant-linked ordering catalog. Repeated pizza sizes, small portions, and kid/side presentations are retained on logical products rather than duplicated.
Frozen raw egg row is a parser artifact from the Caesar Salad advisory/ingredient line and is not a current product.

All four required search classes completed without finding an official matrix or cross-contact disclosure. Direct positive allergens are limited to explicit restaurant/vendor descriptions; all other items are unavailable, with no unsupported negative claims.

proposedChanges: Replace the 80-row under-extracted baseline with the 109-product current logical union of the official standing menu, homepage weekly specials, and linked ordering menu.
Remove the raw egg artifact; add missed standing-menu Pasta and Bread plus current order-only desserts, beverages, dough, sauce, and weekly products.
Consolidate repeated pizza sizes, small salad/gelato portions, and kid/side presentations while retaining source and presentation references.
Preserve description-backed direct positives with restaurant-issued or linked-vendor authority; mark every other item unavailable because no official matrix exists.
